title: 5% LR warmup
description: Set WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.05 (linear LR warmup over first 5% of the 5-min budget), all else unchanged from baseline (DEPTH=8).
reflection: val_bpb 1.014346 vs baseline 1.014027 - essentially no change, marginally worse. Since ASSUME Muon momentum already ramps over the first 300 steps and AdamW's bias correction naturally dampens early updates, adding an explicit LR warmup on top provided no benefit at this scale/budget. Not worth pursuing further; the group's depth-sweep proposals (heavily duplicated this round at DEPTH~10-12) are a more promising lever.
